audience: photographers and artists who sell fine art prints through FinerWorks

useCases.title: Check which orders are in production
useCases.text: The AI lists submitted print orders by production status, or looks up the status of orders by your PO number. You see what is in production and what shipped.

useCases.title: Quote the price of prints
useCases.text: The AI reads the price and price breakdown for product codes or saved SKUs at given quantities. Nothing is ordered or billed.

useCases.title: Get shipping options for a recipient
useCases.text: The AI checks the recipient's address and gets the shipping options and rates for chosen SKUs and quantities.

useCases.title: Browse your saved print products
useCases.text: The AI lists the products in your virtual inventory, filtered by text, SKU or product type, such as canvas prints.

useCases.title: Explore papers, frames, mats and glazing
useCases.text: The AI lists media types, frame collections, mats and glazing options. It can show the frames that fit a given print product.
